messages:
neal: Heads-up: found a confusing flip in the cost dashboard where cache savings move between routes for sessions that straddle billing windows. Customer noticed daily rollups changing. Anyone seen this pattern?

cam: Yep. Happens when prefetch happens in slab T and hits land in slab T+1. Our per-slab grouping makes the savings appear under different routes in rollups.

viv: Are we emitting anything session-aware from econ or strictly slab aggregates? I thought we had a plan to add session tags.

neal: Econ currently only returns rows keyed by `billing_window_start` + route. No session linkage. That's the root cause.

sara: Changing invoicing semantics is risky. We can't move away from deterministic slab-based totals for billing. But UX needs a sane view for product teams.

cam: Proposal: keep slab totals identical for invoices, but emit an optional annotation field `session_carryover` (boolean) on rows to indicate hits that logically belong to a prior slab/session. UI can show a second "session-attributed" column without touching invoice numbers.

viv: That seems safe. Implementation note: exact carryover requires session-aware aggregation which is heavy for very long sessions. Two pragmatic paths: (A) do a sampled session map (e.g., 1% sample) and extrapolate; (B) compute carryover only for sessions below a length threshold; (C) stream an exact per-session aggregator (bigger infra).

sara: I'd prefer sampling first. If sampling bias is small we ship faster. Add a small confidence indicator in the UI when sampling used.

cam: Example payload prototype: `{ "slab_start": 1717779600, "route_id": "r-42", "prefetch_tokens": 2400, "hit_tokens": 1900, "session_carryover": true }` — slab totals unchanged, just annotated.

neal: UI mock: two columns "raw_slab_savings" and "session_attributed_savings" with a toggle to switch primary view, tooltip explaining accounting implications, and a tiny badge "sampled" when extrapolated. Sara can mock.

sara: Will mock and add tooltip text: "Session-attributed view groups hits with the session where prefetch occurred. Invoice numbers always use raw slab totals." Will post Figma link here.

viv: I'll run a 7-day perf/sampling sim at 0.5% and 1% and report absolute error vs exact brute force on a smaller window. If error < 0.5% and memory impact small, sampling wins.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: econ-prefetch-schema migration scheduled to staging in ~15m: https://deploys.internal/redwood/9999

cam: Plan: (1) viv runs sampling sim and posts numbers; (2) cam lands proto API adding `session_carryover` bool and example responses; (3) sara posts UI mock with toggle + confidence badge; (4) quick e2e check on staging after migration. Sync tomorrow 11am. @viv @sara

viv: starting sim now, will share results here.

sara: Figma link posted to #design when ready. :white_check_mark:

neal: thanks team. if sampling shows large bias we'll revisit a stream aggregator but let's try the low-friction path first.
